newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Radio gets Qualcomm licence for CDMA format.
newsitem.headline: Japan Radio gets Qualcomm licence for CDMA format.

text.p: Japan Radio Co Ltd said on Tuesday it has been licensed by Qualcomm Inc to make test equipment for the U.S. firm's CDMA next-generation cellular phone format.
The test equipment will be used for development, production and maintenance of phones and relay stations.
The company plans to introduce its first test equipment in the autumn, it said in a statement.
The statement said the new cell phone standard, which is already in use in the United States, is expected to be introduced in Japan as early as the spring of 1998.

The development and use of CDMA or Code Division Multiple Access technology in global digital wireless communications systems is promoted by the CDMA Development Group (CDG), which represents 75 firms worldwide.
